[System]: Please review the attached reports and draft playbook, then provide (a) your recommended 60–90 day control posture and step‑down criteria for QuickDrop and VoltHub, and (b) a concise, generalizable set of thresholds and safeguards we should adopt for electronics merchants and branch overrides going forward.
rounds.response:
1) QuickDrop (60–90d): keep ASN/fingerprint blocks, 3DS + bot mitigation, manual review for >$1,000, and POD holds for any reshipper shipments; do not step the reserve down yet but reduce from ~30% to ~20% after 30 consecutive days with (a) zero new flagged‑vector chargebacks, (b) 30‑day CBR <1%, and (c) representment win rate >60%, then reduce a further 10–15% every 30 days meeting the same gates to a 5% floor by day 90. 
2) VoltHub (60–90d): maintain current heightened controls and a temporary reserve of ~25–30%; if 30 days pass with no reshipper concentration, no cross‑merchant recurrence, and 30‑day CBR <1%, step reserve to ~15% and re‑evaluate at 60 days for further reduction to 5%; immediately escalate to suspension/payout hold if reshipper clustering continues, same fingerprint/ASN shows up at ≥3 merchants, or >5 fraud chargebacks in 30 days. 
3) Vertical defaults to adopt now: mandatory 3DS for electronics orders >= $250, enterprise bot mitigation (rate limits/CAPTCHA/WAF) on merchant checkouts, cross‑merchant denylist auto‑blocks for ASNs/fingerprints observed at multiple merchants, and POD holds for any shipments to flagged/reshipper addresses. 
4) Branch/POS rules: enforce a hard‑stop forbidding AVS/CVV overrides for monitored merchants and for in‑branch transactions > $1,000; allow manager+second‑line escalation only for non‑monitored merchants with retained issuer call ref, CCTV/associate ID and in‑tool audit logging for every exception. 
5) Trusted‑local whitelist: permit narrowly scoped carve‑outs only if merchant customer meets all criteria (account >6 months, ≥3 prior purchases, tokenized card + 3DS pass, ship‑to=billing, historical CBR <0.5%), log whitelist usage auditable monthly, and include an immediate kill‑switch; ask Risk Ops + Finance to approve the QuickDrop step‑down schedule and VoltHub reserve, and return consolidated 14‑ and 60‑day metrics (CBR, representment outcomes, cross‑merchant fingerprint/ASN activity) for committee review.
